mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary easing accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that depresses consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when PAYEMS and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In low-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), investors shift capital to equities for yield, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or low-rate regime Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate improving consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when HOUST rises for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and unemployment (UNRATE) indicate stagflation, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL and UNRATE rise for 3 consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), declining industrial output signals weakening corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or contraction regime Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.
